nodes.label: LoopGuard Cloud Expo Prototype
nodes.rationale: Retained one release as a local/demo migration fallback only; unauthenticated with open CORS and in-memory server state, so it must never be exposed to the public internet.

nodes.label: Mission Control Screen
nodes.rationale: On a flagged loop it shows a decision card with four genuine actions — Approve fix, Continue once, Allow tool, Terminate — plus free-text correction.

nodes.label: Legacy Demo Server (loopguard serve)
nodes.rationale: Defaults to loopback; a LAN demo requires an explicit temporary --host 0.0.0.0 flag on a trusted network because this compatibility path has no auth.
